messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need to slim the Hosted API roadmap for the upcoming quarter. Customers are escalating embeddings latency and a few customers (Acme/Strata) want a rerank SLA. My proposal: prioritize an embeddings SLO (P95 latency targets + regression guardrails) + a lightweight rerank canary. Push speculative gen UX items to the following quarter. Thoughts?
kevin: +1 on slimming. question: do we mean an infra-backed SLO (reserved capacity) or product-level SLO with fallbacks? capacity costs differ a lot. :thinking_face: 
olivia: We can do a product-level SLO initially with automatic fallback to a cheaper model when latency spikes. Need clear metrics: target P95 < 120ms for embeddings for small vectors? what about throughput buckets (1q/s, 10q/s)?
derek: Cost note — reserving GPUs for tight P95 will blow up monthly commits. Alternative: aggressive KV prefix caching + batching suggestions and quantized model recommendation to keep costs down. Also: define canary failure modes (error rate, latency, quality regression).
sophie: From CS: Acme needs 99.5% availability and <150ms P95 for embeddings for their 10 qps tail. They will pay for reserved capacity if we offer easy upgrade path. Also they want a documented rollback plan.
kevin: If we do a canary for rerank, propose this config:```json
{
  "pct": 5,
  "duration_days": 7,
  "region_split": ["us-west-2","us-east-1"],
  "slo_checks": {"p95_latency_ms": 200, "model_quality_delta": 0.02}
}```
maya: Nice config. We should add an automated quality check tied to our eval harness (prompt set A). If quality delta > threshold, auto-rollback.
olivia: Agree. Also we need a launch checklist item for observability: per-route token cost, p95/p99, cache hit ratio, and top 10 prompt regressions.
derek: Quick engineering tradeoff: to hit 120ms P95 we might need a quantized 4-bit variant for embeddings. That implies additional onboarding work to validate vectors across customers. Planning estimate: 2 engs for 3 sprints to validate quantized variant and perf regressions.
sophie: Customer ask: can we surface a simple plan and pricing: "Embeddings SLO add-on" + "Rerank canary service" — they want to see it by EOW for procurement.
maya: Action items: 1) Olivia/derek: scope validation plan for quantized embeddings + perf targets (due Tue). 2) Kevin: draft canary config + rollback automation (due Wed). 3) Sophie: capture customer commitments and pricing language (due Fri). 4) I'll update roadmap doc and propose which gen UX items get bumped.
product-bot: Roadmap link: https://redwood.internal/roadmap/hosted-api/q3-slimming (autogenerated snapshot) :link:
kevin: +1 to that timeline. small ask — add an explicit metric for "quality delta" definition (AUC/accuracy on rerank eval set) so CS can communicate it to customers.
maya: Good call. I'll add wording: "quality delta = change in rerank NDCG@10 on canonical eval set".
olivia: one more ops note — set canary alerting to page on p95>250ms or error rate>1% for the canary slice only.
derek: tagging infra: @kevin please confirm capacity implications after your canary write-up.
sophie: I'll prep customer-facing one-pager and share with Acme this afternoon.
maya: Thanks all. We'll re-check Wed after Kevin's draft. :thumbsup:
